requirements: R1: The backend health check endpoint must be reachable and return a success status.
R2: The backup script must run successfully without container volume mount errors.

slices.title: Patch docker-compose for backend health and backup script execution
slices.jtbd: When implementing initialization repairs for this epic, I want the container configuration fixed, so that the application boots and passes health checks
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the application launch sequence
When the containers are brought up
Then the backend container becomes healthy
And the backup container does not fail with an 'Is a directory' error
